title: The Noetherian Case of Bayart's Power-Series Question
summary: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring. We prove that if the one-variable formal power-series ring $R[[x]]$ is a unique factorization domain, then so is the two-variable formal power-series ring $R[[x,y]]$. This resolves a question raised by Bayart in 1973 for Noetherian coefficient rings. The proof uses the divisor theory of Noetherian normal domains, expressed through finite rank-one reflexive modules.
